days.title: Rivers and Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Fuentes Carrionas
stops.detail: It owed its original name to the two spots known as Fuentes Carrionas and Fuente del Cobre, considered the sources of the Carrión and Pisuerga rivers, respectively, and was later renamed after the region where it is located, the Montaña Palentina.

stops.name: Cueva del Cobre
stops.detail: Cueva del Cobre: Interesting cavity, not only for being the source of the Pisuerga River, but also for the formations and dimensions of its galleries.

stops.name: Tejeda de Tosande
stops.detail: Tejeda de Tosande, one of the most notable yew forests in Western Europe; the Pinar de Velilla, one of the few natural pine forests in the Mountain Range; Enebral de Peñas Lampas, the northernmost formation of Spanish juniper in its entire distribution area.

stops.name: sumidero del Sel de la Fuente
stops.detail: Sel de la Fuente sinkhole, in the Sierra de Híjar: Cavity that collects the waters of the glacial cirque of the Valdecebollas peak.
